# Fort Pierce Mold & Restoration

> Ceiling mold remediation in Fort Pierce, Florida. Containment-first mold removal from bathroom ceilings, drywall ceilings, water-damaged ceilings and attic-side cavities, plus drywall repair and repainting. Emergency line answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Business facts
- Name: Fort Pierce Mold & Restoration
- Website: https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/
- Service: ceiling mold remediation and ceiling repair (mold remediation)
- Address: 3705 Okeechobee Rd, Fort Pierce, FL 34947, United States
- Phone: (772) 710-1549 (+17727101549)
- Email: info@ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Service area: Fort Pierce and St. Lucie County, Florida (ZIP codes 34945, 34946, 34947, 34948, 34949, 34950, 34951, 34954, 34979, 34981, 34982)
- Pricing: written estimate after an on-site look. Typical professional mold remediation runs about $10 to $25 per square foot nationally; see the cost guide.
- Florida rule of thumb: licensed mold remediation is required for mold-contaminated areas larger than 10 contiguous square feet (Florida Statutes Chapter 468, Part XVI). A licensed assessor and a licensed remediator cannot be the same party on the same project.

## Services
- [Bathroom Ceiling Mold Removal in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/bathroom-ceiling-mold-removal/): Mold on bathroom and shower ceilings, around exhaust fans and in corners, removed and repaired.
- [Drywall Ceiling Mold Removal in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/drywall-ceiling-mold-removal/): Mold in ceiling and wall drywall, including knockdown, orange peel and popcorn textures.
- [Ceiling Mold Repair in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/ceiling-mold-repair/): Rebuilding the ceiling after mold removal: drywall, texture matching, primer and paint.
- [Water-Damaged Ceiling Mold Removal in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/water-damage-ceiling-mold/): Mold after a roof leak, storm damage or plumbing leak soaked the ceiling.
- [Air-Conditioning Condensation Ceiling Mold in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/ac-condensation-ceiling-mold/): Dark spots around vents and stains under the air handler from condensation and clogged drain lines.
- [Attic Mold Above the Ceiling in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/attic-mold-above-ceiling/): Mold on roof decking, trusses and wet insulation above the ceiling.
- [Emergency Ceiling Mold Removal in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/emergency-ceiling-mold-removal/): Sagging ceilings, active leaks and fast-spreading mold, any hour of the day.
- [Ceiling Mold Removal Cost in Fort Pierce, FL](https://ceilingmoldremediationfortpiercefl.com/services/ceiling-mold-removal-cost/): Price ranges by job size, what drives the cost, and how to compare quotes.
